Pizza Legacy v0.0.1 - Windows Release
===============================

Pizza Legacy is an open-source reimplementation of the 1994 DOS game
Pizza Connection/Pizza Tycoon.


REQUIREMENTS
------------
The game requires the asset files from the original Pizza Tycoon / Pizza
Connection. Point the game at your installation directory on first launch
(the folder containing PT.EXE).

The original game (Pizza Connection) is available on GOG and Steam, frequently on sale for
under a euro.

STATUS
------
Alpha. Expect rough edges and missing features. Development is active.
See https://pizzalegacy.nl for current status.

INCLUDED FILES
--------------
 plegacy.exe       - Game executable
 SDL2.dll          - SDL2 (zlib license)
 zlib1.dll         - zlib (zlib license)
 libpng16.dll      - libpng (libpng license)
 ADLMIDI.dll       - libADLMIDI (GPL v3+)
                     Source: https://github.com/Wohlstand/libADLMIDI
